benefits.text: BBIA Eau Stay Concealer 2-in-1 can be used as a foundation or a concealer, helping to effectively cover imperfections on the skin. The lightweight cream adheres firmly to the skin and does not irritate sensitive skin. The product helps makeup color last for 24 hours. The applicator is designed like a spoon and made of PC material, helping you pick up just the right amount of product easily and conveniently.

howToUse.text:
Use the applicator to take an appropriate amount of product and apply it to areas that need coverage, such as dark circles, blemishes or freckles.
Can be used as a foundation over the whole face for a perfect makeup look.

safety.text:
For external use only; do not use on damaged skin
Discontinue use if signs of irritation appear, and keep out of reach of children.

sellingPoints.text: 2-in-1 coverage & foundation; long-lasting color for 24h; spoon-shaped applicator makes it easy to pick up just the right amount.
